_readme: DEFAULT-CLOSED compliance gate for wallets, NFTs, play-to-earn and wagering. 'off' = nothing runs. 'sandbox' = play-money and testnet only, no real value. 'live' needs EVERY item in 'licence' filled in by the owner, jurisdictions allow-listed, and the server started with NIGHTHAWK_ECONOMY_LIVE=1. The browser can never change this file or turn anything on. Not legal advice: see docs/ECONOMY.md.
